summary: Horizontal or vertical rule between regions; set decorative when the line only adds visual separation.

usage.text: orientation="vertical" makes the host inline-flex with align-self: stretch, so place it in a flex row: it fills the row's height, at least 1.5rem.
It draws only a line and has no slot, so it cannot carry a label such as "or"; put any text in sibling elements.

a11y.text: Horizontal renders a native hr; vertical renders an element with role="separator" and aria-orientation="vertical". Both live in its shadow root, not on the host.
The decorative attribute hides the rule from assistive technology (aria-hidden, and role=presentation when vertical). Use it where a separator would only add noise.
